name: Tm Visualization Suite: Variance & Targets
pitch: Compare actual values with plan, prior, target, and range scenarios in five charts.
question: How does actual compare with plan, prior, target, or an accepted range?
useWhen: Compare one measure with a plan, prior, target, or range.
features: Compare actual with target, plan, and prior in a bullet chart.
Reconcile a reference total into an actual total in a waterfall.
Show the signed difference for each item in variance bars.
Mark actual values inside or outside an authored range.
Compare cumulative actual with cumulative plan and a final target.
Read one difference rule: actual minus reference, in one unit.

hero.alt: Bullet chart of actual values with a target tick, a plan circle, and range zones for each item.

screenshots.alt: Waterfall chart with a reference total bar, one floating bar for each item, and an actual total.
screenshots.caption: See which items move the total.

screenshots.alt: Target band chart of actual points inside and outside an accepted range over twelve months.
screenshots.caption: Read values inside and outside a range.
